review.headline: Easy 9 km completed on target distance, steady at 5:42/km and 138 bpm.
observations: Distance 8.99 km against a 9.0 km plan, fully covered.
Every km split was 5:42/km (342 s), showing very even pacing.
Average HR 138 bpm with no drift, consistent with relaxed conversational effort.
Pace sits inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy band, in the upper-middle portion, which suits recovery after Tuesday's tempo session.
flags: RPE was not recorded and the athlete note is empty, so perceived effort cannot be confirmed.
